## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D2. This is audit backlog UX-14 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: /consult/:id · doctor · 1024 px and wider first, then 768 to 1023.
Findings and reviewers: F-11, F-03 · reviewers A-13, B-04, C-10.
Rationale: One simple visit takes about 24 clicks, 9 typed fields and 5 route changes. The page is 3,600 to 5,350 px tall; the first note field is at 440 to 1,138 px; at 1024 px the chart panel drops to the bottom; 3 % of a 1024 by 768 screen is working content. The route changes also trigger the stale-note defect.
Proposed UX behaviour: One workspace, as in blueprint section 8. Under the pinned strip: pinned section anchors (44 px) with completion marks in icon and words; vitals from the nurse as one row; History, Examination, Assessment with diagnoses added inline (no route change; the problems page stays reachable); Prescription directly after Assessment, still added through the existing Add medicine dialog, with the allergy and interaction result beside each medicine line; Plan, tests and follow-up; the layout footer with save status, what is left, Preview prescription and Review and sign. The chart panel (Chart, Past visits, Checklist) is beside the note at 1024 px and wider (360 px) and a drawer opened from the strip from 768 to 1023 px. The note column is at most 860 px wide and typed text is 16 px. The guided-steps view stays as an option. The controllers, the save model and every rule are unchanged. The seven guarantees of arbitration ruling 3 hold: pinned strip with the allergy in words; sign, authorise, place orders and end are four separate recorded acts; End asks when a draft exists; nothing focusable under pinned chrome; the allergy result beside the medicine line; no route change for diagnoses and medicines; no tick the doctor did not earn.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/medvya-workspace-concept.html, doctor view at 1440, 1024 and 768, audit notes 4, 5, 6 and 7; screenshots docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/screenshots/doctor-1440.png, doctor-1440-annotated.png, doctor-1024.png, doctor-768.png, doctor-768-chart-open.png. The medicine box in the concept is a sketch and is not built.
Components and tokens affected: SplitLayout, Sheet, StickyActionBar, SaveStatus, Card and Section, SegmentedControl (one page or guided steps). Width tokens (note 860, panel 360).
Front end and back end split: Front end only. No controller or API change.
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by: the pinned-strip screen ticket; the note-shows-what-the-server-holds ticket; the codemod; the page components ticket; the End-with-unfinished-prescription ticket and the honest-checklist ticket (guarantees 3 and 7 must be true before the layout makes ending and signing easier). Owns ConsultStudio.tsx and the consultation specs while open.
Clinical sign-off: Required before merge: question 7 (section order; prescription after assessment; diagnosis inline; one page or guided steps on the room tablet) of the validation plan, recorded on the issue with a date. Doctor scenario steps 1 to 9 of the plan are the session script.
Effort and regression risk: L · High: 13 test files and 79 references; J2 alone has about 60 locators. One change per region, J1 to J6 green on each.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) An inline free-text medicine box: the existing Add medicine dialog stays until the free-text allergy rule is closed and a clinician has seen a replacement (ruling 3). (2) The queue rail (its own ticket, after the queue rule). (3) Writing on a phone (phone rule ticket). (4) Any change to section content, required fields, vitals ranges or safety-check text. (5) Merging sign and authorise.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an open consultation with nurse vitals at 1440 by 900 and 1024 by 768, when the page loads, then the first text box starts at or above 200 px
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the Assessment section, when the doctor adds a coded diagnosis, then the route does not change and the typed note text is still on screen
- [ ] **AC3.** Given 768 by 1024, when the doctor opens the chart from the strip, then the drawer shows allergies, medicines, problems and results in one action and closes back to the same scroll position
- [ ] **AC4.** Given an empty note at 1440 by 900, when the page height is measured, then it is under two viewports
- [ ] **AC5.** Given a note with a draft prescription and an unplaced order, when the doctor presses Review and sign, then only the note is signed, and authorising, placing orders and ending each still need their own action and write their own audit record
- [ ] **AC6.** Given a medicine line for a patient with a recorded allergy, when it is added through the Add medicine dialog, then the check result is shown in words beside that line
- [ ] **AC7.** Given a newly opened consultation, when the section anchors and checklist are read, then no section or item is marked complete
- [ ] **AC8.** Given every control in the workspace, when it is focused by keyboard, then it is fully visible, and pinned chrome takes at most 30 % of the height at 1024 by 768
- [ ] **AC9.** Given text typed in the one-page view, when the doctor switches to guided steps and back, then every word is there
- [ ] **AC10.** Given English and Arabic at 1440, 1024 and 768, when axe runs, then there is no violation and the layout mirrors
